channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Israeli strike on motorcycle kills Palestinian in Gaza City, injures child
item.description: Separate attacks struck central refugee camps as officials warned Gaza's health sector faces total collapse.

item.title: Iran war live: Trump extends sanctions on Iran, Houthi supporters in Sanaa
item.description: Thousands take to the streets in support of Houthis in Sanaa, Trump extends sanctions on Iran.

item.title: Houthis accuse Saudi Arabia of launching 26 strikes in 24 hours
item.description: The war in Yemen intensifies with mounting clashes and reciprocal attacks between Saudi forces and the Houthis.

item.title: Syria arrests five former al-Assad-era officers over strikes on civilians
item.description: Former air officers, including an air force general, were arrested in a series of operations.

item.title: Lebanese artist turns Israeli missile debris into art
item.description: In southern Lebanon, visual artist Lina Jouni transforms debris from Israeli missile strikes into pieces of art.

item.title: Russia’s drones threaten Kyiv-bound Western officials as war effort stalls
item.description: Russia strikes Ukraine’s border crossings with Poland and Moldova as its offensives peter out in the east.

item.title: At least 21 killed after vehicle loaded with explosives rams Pakistan mosque
item.description: A four-year-old child is among those killed in the attack, during which gunmen also opened fire on a police facility.

item.title: Lindsay Clancy holdout juror says he had no doubt she deliberately killed her children
item.description: It is the first time the juror, who refused to side with the others and acquit Clancy, has spoken publicly about his decision.

item.title: Dozens of suspected illegal miners die in Nigerian custody
item.description: Authorities linked the deaths to disease, but this has been disputed by intelligence reports and relatives of the accused.

item.title: 'We simply don't know' - JP Morgan struggling to forecast oil prices due to Trump's war with Iran
item.description: The bank said it "assumed" there would be economic red lines, like oil at $100 a barrel, that the US would be unwilling the cross.
